title: Starbucks Is Hiring Baristas & Shift Supervisors
subtitle: Barista and shift supervisor roles with flexible hours, benefits for part-timers, and training.
ctaLine: Starbucks hires baristas year-round with flexible schedules. See openings near you.
intro: Starbucks hires baristas and shift supervisors across its cafes throughout the country. Barista roles are entry-level with training, often with flexible scheduling that suits students and people balancing other work. Starbucks is also widely known for extending benefits to eligible part-time employees, which sets it apart from many other cafe and retail jobs. Many baristas move up into shift supervisor and store leadership roles over time. Here's an overview of what's typically available and how to apply.

sections.h: What the work is really like day-to-day
sections.p: A barista shift is hands-on and customer-focused. You take orders, prepare espresso drinks and other beverages, handle food items, run the register, and keep the cafe clean and stocked. Mornings can be intense with steady lines, so the work is fast-paced and requires staying organized under pressure. Shift supervisors do the same barista tasks while also directing the team, handling cash, and keeping the shift running smoothly. New hires are trained on recipes and equipment before working solo.
Cafe hours span early mornings through evenings, so schedules are flexible and often built around opening and closing blocks.
bullets: Early opening shifts and evening closing shifts
Part-time schedules that can fit around school
Weekend availability often helps when applying
Exact hours are set by each store

sections.p: Starbucks is well known for offering benefits to eligible part-time as well as full-time employees. Commonly advertised offerings include health coverage options, a college-tuition assistance program, and stock or savings programs, with eligibility depending on hours worked. Confirm the current details and eligibility on the official careers site.
bullets: Benefits available to eligible part-time employees
Free or discounted drinks and beans during shifts
Tips can add to take-home pay in many locations

sections.p: Barista pay varies by location and local wage; shift supervisors earn more. Tips can add to take-home pay in many locations. Confirm details on the official posting.

steps: Choose barista or supervisor and your area
Open the official Starbucks careers site
Apply online and complete any interview steps

faqs.q: Can I move up from barista?
faqs.a: Yes. Many baristas advance to shift supervisor and, over time, into store leadership roles. Advancement depends on performance and openings at your store.
